Applications by e-mail, WhatsApp or by hand cannot be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CAST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CAST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 2 Veterinary Doctors, 2 AHL Assistants, 2 AHL Attendants, 1 AHL Drivers.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CAST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format on page 3 of the notice) and send it to The Secretary, Centre for Assistance and Social Transformation (CAST), At-Gayatri Palace, Patara Sahi, Po-College Square, Dist-Cuttack, Pin-753003, by speed post/registered post/courier, to reach by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Veterinary Doctors: maximum 65 years; AHL Assistants: maximum 55 years; AHL Attendants: maximum 55 years; AHL Drivers: between 18 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹65,000 (Including GST 18% & Charges Service Provider Charges 3.85% for Veterinary Doctors, ₹30,000 (Including GST 18% & Charges Service Provider Charges 3.85% for AHL Assistants, ₹20,000 (Including All Statutory Charges like GST, Service Provider Charges, Administration, EPF, ESI, TDS etc.) for AHL Attendants, ₹25,000 (Including All Statutory Charges like GST, Service Provider Charges, Administration, EPF, ESI, TDS etc.) for AHL Drivers.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Veterinary Doctors: Graduate in Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry with Odisha Veterinary Council registration; AHL Assistants: +2 Science or 2-year Diploma in Animal Sciences or 2 years vocational course in Animal Husbandry/Diary/Poultry/Animal Production; AHL Attendants: 10th Pass/HSC Pass from BSE/CBSE/ICSE Board; AHL Drivers: 10th Pass with valid commercial license and more than 5 years of experience driving commercial vehicles. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. ME Standard Certificate with Odia language (Veterinary Doctors, AHL Assistants, AHL Attendants). Veterinary Doctors must be registered and valid practioner with Odisha Veterinary Council. AHL Attendants and AHL Drivers must be physically fit. AHL Drivers must not have a criminal background.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after due date and time will not be accepted. Applications through e-mail, WhatsApp or by hand cannot be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Documents verification. Interview of short listed candidates. Documents verification of applications received. Short listed candidates informed by phone of interview time and date.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary and contractual engagement through the FNGO CAST, Cuttack under the guidelines of District SPCA, Rayagada.
